name: Anna Stürgkh - § 1 - Am 4
title: REPORT on electricity grids: the backbone of the EU energy system
part_text: 1. Acknowledges that the electricity grid infrastructure plays an essential role in achieving the EU’s strategic autonomy; calls on the Member States to fully explore, optimise, modernise and expand their electricity grid capacity, including transmission and distribution; considers electricity grids to be the central element in the EU’s transition to a competitive economy that is capable of accommodating all available energy solutions through a technology-neutral approach and/or evolving demand sources driven by the advancement of digital technologies; underlines the Member States’ prerogative to determine their own energy mix; considers technology neutrality to be a core principle;
